# Track your household budget with AI: simple steps for beginners

Getting control of your household spending does not require complex spreadsheets or expensive software. By the end of this guide, you will know how to use a free AI assistant to organise your everyday expenses and find quick, realistic ways to save money.

## Before you start
- **An AI assistant account:** You can use any free chat tool, such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Google Gemini.
- **Your recent spending details:** Have a quick list of recent transactions ready (for example, from your bank app, a paper receipt, or just your memory).

## Step 1 — Collect your raw spending data
You do not need to format your numbers perfectly. One of the best things about AI is that it can understand messy lists. Simply type out or copy and paste your transactions into a rough list. 

💬 **Example:** 
> *Coffee $5.20, Petrol $75.00, Groceries $140.00, Electricity bill $195.00, Netflix $19.00, Takeaway dinner $45.00.*

## Step 2 — Feed the data to your AI
Now, you will write a **prompt** (the instruction you give to an AI, written in plain language) to help the tool sort your spending. Open your AI tool, copy the prompt below, paste your messy list at the end, and press send.

💬 **Example prompt:**
> *"Please categorise the following list of household expenses into clear groups (like Food, Utilities, and Transport) and show me the total spent in each group: [Paste your list here]"*

The AI will read your list, group the items logically, and calculate the sub-totals for you in seconds.

## Step 3 — Ask for personalised saving tips
Once the AI has organised your spending, you can use it as a friendly financial sounding board. Because it already "remembers" the categories you just created, you can ask for tailored advice on where you might be able to trim costs.

💬 **Example prompt:**
> *"Looking at these categories, can you suggest three realistic and gentle ways I could reduce my spending next week without making major lifestyle sacrifices?"*

## Step 4 — Create a simple weekly template
To keep the momentum going, ask the AI to design a clean, personalized template that you can use to track your spending manually next week. 

💬 **Example prompt:**
> *"Create a simple weekly budget template for me based on these exact categories. Keep it clean so I can copy and paste it into a blank document to write in my actual spending next week."*

---

## Common mistakes
- **Sharing sensitive personal information:** Watch out for account numbers, tax file numbers, or home addresses. Always delete private details from your bank statements before pasting them into an AI tool.
- **Expecting perfect maths:** AI is a text-based tool, not a calculator. While it is excellent at categorising, it can occasionally make minor adding mistakes with very long lists of numbers. Always do a quick manual check of the final total.

---

## What this means for you

- **In everyday life:** You can instantly understand where your money is going without spending hours squinting at complex spreadsheets.
- **For your business or work:** You can use these exact same sorting techniques to categorise your business receipts or project expenses before tax time.
- **If you're just getting started:** Keep it incredibly simple. Start by analysing just one weekend's worth of transactions to see how easy the process is.

---

## Try it now
Open your preferred AI assistant right now, copy the text below, and hit send:

> *"Here is my spending from yesterday: Cafe breakfast $24, Train fare $4.50, Supermarket top-up $38. Can you put these into categories and tell me my total spend?"*
